question: Heparin is the commonly used anticoagulant in cardiac surgery. All of the following are true about heparin except-

options.opa: Weakest acid found in living things
options.opb: Most commercial preparations of heparin now utilize pig intestinal slimes

analysis: Heparin is a commonly used anticoagulant in cardiac surgery and acts via Antithrombin activation. It is not the weakest acid found in living things, and most commercial preparations of heparin do utilize pig intestinal slimes. Thrombocytopenia is a known side effect of heparin therapy.
